hypotheses.reasoning: The auth-svc-reconciler transaction 85871 sat idle in a transaction and held a lock on the accounts table (#199). Other UPDATEs on accounts waited on it (#205). auth-svc queries then hit the 10s statement timeout (#210, #218). That made account-svc's issueToken calls time out (#211). The auth-svc connection pool then saturated, and edge-proxy returned 504s on /login. The saturation and the 504s are downstream symptoms.

verdict.recommendedAction: Terminate the idle-in-transaction session 85871 (the auth-svc-reconciler) on accounts-db to release the lock. Then fix the reconciler so it commits promptly. Set idle_in_transaction_session_timeout on accounts-db.
